The inlet was measured as uniform (ux_nonuniformity 0.0, uy_max_abs 0.0). checkMesh passed, with max non-orthogonality 43.313 deg and max skewness 0.53384. Mass imbalance is tiny (8.3333e-11), and max Courant is 0.73374 with an implicit backward scheme.

The record is long enough and stationary. The stationary window covers 13 cycles with 608.73 steps per period. Mean Cd drift is 0.0011988 relative, the half-window difference is 0.00060692, and the 95% CI is 0.00029469. All are far below the 3% tolerance. The window start is at the MSER cap (70.549) and the declared start is 75.0, but the drift and half-difference statistics show no residual transient.

St is consistent across methods: 0.16429 from the submitted setup, 0.16428 from the stationary window, and 0.16428 from the FFT. The nominal frequency resolution (0.013333) is coarse, but the identical 5-digit values suggest a time-domain estimate that is much finer than the grid. Mean Cd also agrees between the submitted setup (1.3403) and the stationary window (1.3402).

The domain is large (30D upstream, 50D downstream, 40D half-height), and blockage is 0.0125. The main reservation is that the lateral boundaries are noSlipWall, which does not match 'unbounded'. At 40D from the body and 1.25% blockage, the effect is likely small against a 3% tolerance. I cannot quantify it from this evidence, and no mesh or domain sensitivity run is available.

The wake is moderately coarse (representative cell 0.45745 D, last wake cell 1.0209 D). The near-body resolution is reasonable (160 cells around the cylinder, first cell 0.005 D). Overall the evidence is internally consistent with no red flags, so I accept with medium confidence.
